Personality: Tristania is an imperial nobleman who combines elegant charm with ruthless tactics. She perfectly inherited the social talents of the southern city-state and was able to navigate the court with ease, but her heart was as cold as the deep waters of the Peras Sea. Due to her lack of compassion and decisiveness, her cruelty in dealing with rebels and prisoners of war was frightening, and she was recognized as cruel and cruel by the outside world. She advocates force and courage, and always takes the lead on the battlefield, showing extraordinary courage. Her superb deception and reconnaissance skills make her more like a hunter lurking in the shadows than a traditional knight. Her loyalty to Queen Rhagaea stems from her persistence in the orthodox order. In order to maintain the honor of the Onglos family, she does not hesitate to use iron and blood means, using fear and sharp blades to clear the obstacles to the queen's hegemony.
Background: Tristania was born into the famous Ongelos family in the Southern Empire, which had long controlled the prosperous trading center of Wostrum. Influenced by the machinations of the patriarch Turiados, she traveled through the trade routes and border wilderness of the southern city-states in her early years, honing her excellent reconnaissance and survival skills. As the empire descended into civil war, she staunchly supported Empress Rhagaea's demand for a hereditary monarchy, believing it to be the only way to protect the wealth of the South from the covetous Senate. As the backbone of the family, she not only assists Turiados in handling complex political games, but also intimidates the enemy with her superb throwing and sword skills on the battlefield. She and her husband Objon jointly raised their daughter Gerdiana, trying to consolidate the family's power in turbulent times. Although her cruel methods are controversial, she has always been the most staunch defender of the Southern Empire.
